name: New One
one_liner: One billion builders and founders in a single company that holds a share of an ecosystem of companies — you own what you build, plus a sliver of everything else built beside it.
notes: Sibling to foundernees, deliberately separate. Foundernees makes builders; New One is what they build into. Local dev on port 3211 (foundernees holds 3210). No domain yet — site.url is a placeholder. Same standing no-launch rule applies until the operator says otherwise.
